description:
Several public matrix, sparse-matrix, and bit-vector operations omit the sections the project requires: cost characteristics on operations whose cost is not obvious, panic conditions on operations that can panic, and examples where the contract is not evident from the signature.

## Background

Four groups are affected. The pivot search at `crates/gf2-core/src/matrix.rs:987` states neither its cost nor how it behaves, and the dense-to-sparse conversion beside it omits its cost despite scaling with the full matrix area. The sparse conversions at `crates/gf2-core/src/sparse.rs:890` carry a single sentence each with no cost, no panic conditions, and no example. The two bit-scan operations at `crates/gf2-core/src/bitvec.rs:847` and `:873` omit cost, while their two immediate siblings state it.

The project documents examples where they clarify a non-obvious contract, not on items whose signature already says everything. These four groups qualify because the traversal order, the early-exit behaviour, and the panic delegation are not visible from the signatures.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The pivot search states its cost and carries an example showing what it returns when no pivot exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: The dense-to-sparse conversion states its cost in terms of the matrix dimensions.
- [hard] REQ-03: Both sparse conversions state their cost, their panic conditions including any delegated from the element accessor, and carry an example.
- [hard] REQ-04: Both bit-scan operations state their cost, including the early-exit behaviour, in the same terms their two siblings use.
- [hard] REQ-05: Every example added compiles and passes as a documentation test.
- [hard] REQ-06: No example is added to an accessor, constant, simple constructor, predicate, or direct field mapping.
- [hard] REQ-07: Clippy with warnings denied and formatting pass.
title: Complete the missing doc sections on gf2-core matrix and bit-vector APIs
